name: Tenuicruris
sum: Albian enantiornithean from the Toolebuc Formation of Queensland, the second Mesozoic bird named from Australia.
holotype: KK F1451, an isolated leg bone, Kronosaurus Korner Museum, Richmond.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: White et al. 2026
